The '''Kessel Hop''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|route]] terminating at the [[Zebitrope system/Legends|Zebitrope system]], which was connected to the [[Cadma system/Legends|Cadma system]] via the [[Cadma Conduit]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] route.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
